거기.x: Please wait there. I'll come to you.
거기.e: Same 이/그/저 pattern: 여기 (here), 거기 (there), 저기 (over there).

감자.x: I boiled some potatoes and ate them.
감자.e: From an older Sino-Korean word for 'sweet tuber'. Sweet potato is now 고구마.

빼다.m: to take out, to remove, to leave out; to lose (weight); to subtract
빼다.x: I lost 5 kilos for my health.
빼다.e: Opposite of 넣다 (to put in); 빠지다 is its 'come out by itself' partner.
빼다.t: Handy when ordering food: 오이 빼 주세요 = Please leave out the cucumber.
rel: to fall out, to be lost

끼다.m: to put on, to wear (glasses, gloves, rings); to fit into
끼다.x: My eyesight is bad, so I wear glasses.
끼다.e: Short form of 끼우다 'to insert'. Homonym: 끼다 also means 'to form' (fog, clouds).
끼다.t: Use 끼다 for things you slip on: rings, gloves, contact lenses; glasses take 끼다 or 쓰다.

퇴근.ex: 퇴근 후에 친구하고 저녁을 먹기로 했어요.
퇴근.x: I decided to have dinner with a friend after work.
퇴근.t: 퇴근 후에 'after work' is a very common phrase for evening plans.

전화를 걸다.forms: 전화를 걸어요 · 걸었어요 · 걸 거예요 · 거세요 (ㄹ drops)
전화를 걸다.m: to make a phone call, to call
전화를 걸다.ex: 어제 저녁에 고향에 계신 어머니께 전화를 걸었어요.
전화를 걸다.x: Yesterday evening I called my mother back home.
전화를 걸다.e: 걸다 means 'to hang, to hook': you hook up a line to someone.
전화를 걸다.t: In speech 전화하다 is more common; 전화를 걸다 stresses dialing the call.

둘째.ex: 우리 둘째 딸은 집 근처 고등학교에 다녀요.
둘째.x: Our second daughter goes to a high school near home.

가지.forms: 한 가지 · 두 가지 · 여러 가지
가지.ex: 이 식당에는 여러 가지 메뉴가 있어요.
가지.x: This restaurant has many kinds of dishes on the menu.
가지.e: Homonym warning: other 가지 words mean 'branch' and 'eggplant'.
가지.t: Count with native numbers: 한 가지, 두 가지, 세 가지.

간단하다.m: to be simple, to be easy, to be brief
간단하다.x: I was busy, so I had a quick, simple lunch of gimbap.

의미.x: I'm not sure what this word means.
의미.t: 뜻 is the everyday native synonym; 의미 also covers 'significance', as in 의미가 있다.

표현.ex: 한국어로 제 마음을 표현하기가 아직 어려워요.
표현.x: It's still hard for me to express my feelings in Korean.

튀김.ex: 오징어 튀김을 떡볶이 국물에 찍어 먹어요.
튀김.x: I dip squid fritters in the tteokbokki sauce.
튀김.t: Snack-bar 튀김 includes squid, sweet potato, dumplings and 김말이 (glass noodles rolled in seaweed).

냠냠.x: The baby is happily munching on her baby food.
냠냠.e: Both 의성어 and 의태어: the sound and look of someone eating with relish.
냠냠.t: Parents tell toddlers 냠냠 먹자! 'Let's eat up!'. Adults use it in cute food posts online.

신고.x: I saw a thief and reported it to the police.
신고.e: Literally 'state and report' to an official body.

체험하다.m: to experience firsthand, to try out
체험하다.ex: 이번 여행에서 한국의 시골 생활을 직접 체험했어요.
체험하다.x: On this trip, I experienced Korean country life firsthand.
체험하다.e: Literally 'test with the body' plus 하다.

우연.x: What a coincidence to run into you here!

연결.t: On the phone, 연결해 드릴게요 means 'I'll put you through.'

인류.x: Environmental problems are a problem for all of humanity.
인류.t: Pronounced [일류] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ; don't confuse with 일류 'first-class'.

비만.ex: 비만은 여러 가지 병의 원인이 될 수 있어요.
비만.x: Obesity can be the cause of many diseases.
비만.t: 비만 is a medical term; calling a person 뚱뚱하다 to their face is rude.

교체하다.x: We replaced the old windows with new ones.
교체하다.t: Common pattern: A를 B로 교체하다, 'replace A with B'.

데뷔하다.m: to debut, to make one's debut
데뷔하다.x: That group debuted three years ago.
데뷔하다.t: K-pop idols usually train for years as trainees (연습생) before they debut. 데뷔 무대 = debut stage.

노동력.x: In the countryside, there aren't nearly enough workers.
노동력.e: Literally 'work power'; -력 = power or ability: 노동력, 경쟁력.
노동력.t: Pronounced [노동녁] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

골절.x: I fell and fractured my arm.
골절.t: Pronounced [골쩔]; in conversation people usually say 뼈가 부러졌어요.

대변.x: The hospital told me to get a stool test.
대변.e: Literally 'big excretion' — the word for poop.
대변.t: 대변 is medical and polite; 똥 is the casual word.

하드웨어.ex: 하드웨어가 오래돼서 새 게임이 잘 안 돌아가요.
하드웨어.x: My hardware is old, so new games don't run well.
하드웨어.e: From English 'hardware'; only the computer sense, never tools.

오작동.x: The fire alarm went off because of a sensor malfunction.

절망적.x: The situation was hopeless, but we didn't give up.

차마.forms: 차마 + negative: 차마 ~지 못하다, 차마 ~ㄹ 수 없다
차마.m: (cannot) bear to, (not) have the heart to
차마.ex: 친구의 슬픈 얼굴을 보니 차마 사실을 말할 수 없었어요.
차마.x: Seeing my friend's sad face, I couldn't bring myself to tell the truth.
차마.t: Only used with 못/없다 negatives and conveys emotional reluctance, not inability.

시달리다.m: to suffer (from), to be troubled by, to be tormented
시달리다.x: These days many office workers suffer from stress.
시달리다.t: Pattern: N에 시달리다 — 불면증에, 소음에, 빚에 시달리다.

헤아리다.m: to count; to understand, consider (someone's feelings)
헤아리다.ex: 이제야 부모님의 마음을 헤아릴 수 있어요.
헤아리다.x: Only now can I understand how my parents feel.

이색적.x: This café's interior is really unusual.
이색적.e: Literally 'of a different color'; -적 = '-ic/-al': 이색적, 획기적, 과학적.
이색적.t: Common in ads and travel writing: 이색 체험 'unusual experience', 이색 카페 'quirky café'.

폭신폭신.x: This sofa is soft and cushiony, so it's comfortable to sit on.
폭신폭신.e: 의태어 (manner word) for something soft that gently sinks when pressed. Its dark-vowel pair 푹신푹신 feels deeper and softer.
폭신폭신.t: Pronounced [폭씬폭씬]: the ㄱ batchim makes the next ㅅ tense. Also used for fluffy food like pancakes: 폭신폭신한 팬케이크.

새벽 배송.ex: 밤에 주문하면 새벽 배송으로 아침에 받아요.
새벽 배송.x: If I order at night, it comes by early-morning delivery and I get it in the morning.
새벽 배송.t: Orders placed by late evening arrive at your door by about 7 a.m.; especially popular for groceries.

탈모.x: Lately I've started losing hair because of stress.
탈모.t: Anti-hair-loss shampoo (탈모 샴푸) is a big product category in Korea.

외환.x: The government worked to stabilize the foreign exchange market.
외환.e: Short for 외국환 'foreign exchange'; 외환 위기 recalls Korea's 1997 financial crisis.

재범.ex: 정부는 재범을 막기 위한 프로그램을 만들었습니다.
재범.x: The government created a program to prevent repeat offenses.

선정적.ex: 일부 언론은 선정적인 제목으로 독자를 끌어요.
선정적.x: Some media outlets attract readers with sensational headlines.
선정적.t: Homonym: 선정 also means 'selection' (as in 수상자 선정); 선정적 always means 'sensational, provocative'.

전파.x: The news spread quickly through social media.
전파.t: Homonym: 전파 (電波) means 'radio waves', as in 전파가 약하다.

전파.ex: 산속에서는 전파가 약해서 휴대폰이 잘 안 돼요.
전파.x: In the mountains, the signal is weak, so cell phones don't work well.
전파.t: Homonym 전파 傳播 means 'spread, propagation', as in 바이러스 전파; context tells them apart.

해일.ex: 지진 후에 해일이 해안 마을을 덮쳤습니다.
해일.x: After the earthquake, a tidal wave struck the coastal village.

도모하다.m: to promote, to seek, to work toward (a goal)
도모하다.ex: 두 나라는 경제 협력을 도모하기로 합의했습니다.
도모하다.x: The two countries agreed to pursue economic cooperation.
도모하다.e: Literally 'planning and scheming' — but in modern use it's neutral: working toward something.

구구절절.m: every single word and line; at great length, in detail
구구절절.ex: 그의 편지에는 미안한 마음이 구구절절 담겨 있었어요.
구구절절.x: Every line of his letter was full of how sorry he was.
구구절절.t: Also adverbial and can sound negative—long-winded: 구구절절 변명하다 'to make lengthy excuses.'

기조.m: keynote, basic tone; underlying policy or stance
기조.ex: 정부는 경제 정책의 기조를 그대로 유지하기로 했습니다.
기조.x: The government decided to keep the basic direction of its economic policy.
기조.e: Literally 'base tone' — the keynote everything else follows.

단초.m: a clue, a first step, a starting point (toward a solution)
단초.ex: 이 연구가 문제 해결의 단초를 제공했습니다.
단초.x: This research provided a first clue to solving the problem.
단초.e: Literally 'tip and beginning' — the loose end you start pulling from.

지하자원.ex: 이 나라는 석유 같은 지하자원이 풍부합니다.
지하자원.x: This country is rich in underground resources such as oil.

상대 평가.m: relative grading, grading on a curve
상대 평가.ex: 상대 평가에서는 다른 학생들과 점수를 비교해요.
상대 평가.x: In relative grading, your score is compared with other students'.
상대 평가.e: Literally 'evaluation against each other' — grading on a curve.

분권.ex: 권력이 한곳에 모이지 않도록 분권이 필요해요.
분권.x: Decentralization is needed so that power isn't concentrated in one place.
분권.t: Pronounced [분꿘] — the ㄱ of 권 is tensed.

노장사상.m: the philosophy of Laozi and Zhuangzi, Taoist thought
노장사상.ex: 노장사상은 욕심을 버리고 자연을 따르라고 가르쳐요.
노장사상.x: Taoist thought teaches us to let go of greed and follow nature.
노장사상.e: 노 = Laozi and 장 = Zhuangzi, plus 사상 'thought'.

권력욕.m: lust for power, desire for power
권력욕.ex: 권력욕에 사로잡힌 정치인은 결국 신뢰를 잃었습니다.
권력욕.x: The politician consumed by a lust for power eventually lost the public's trust.
권력욕.t: Pronounced [궐려굑]: ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ, then ㄱ links to 욕.

아련하다.m: to be faint, hazy; wistfully dim (of memories)
아련하다.x: Memories of my childhood come back faintly.
아련하다.e: Native word for something blurry and far away, often with a nostalgic, bittersweet feel.
아련하다.t: Common pattern: 아련한 추억 / 기억, 아련하게 떠오르다.

기생충.ex: 날고기를 먹으면 기생충에 감염될 수 있어요.
기생충.x: Eating raw meat can give you a parasite infection.
기생충.e: Literally 'a bug that lives lodged in another'.
기생충.t: Used figuratively for a freeloader who lives off others, as in the film 기생충 (Parasite, 2019).

포화.ex: 물에 소금이 더 이상 녹지 않으면 포화 상태입니다.
포화.x: When no more salt dissolves in water, it is in a saturated state.
포화.t: Also used figuratively: 시장이 포화 상태다 means 'the market is saturated'.

연산.ex: 컴퓨터는 복잡한 연산을 아주 빠르게 처리합니다.
연산.x: Computers process complex calculations very quickly.
연산.t: 연산 is the technical word; in everyday talk about money or numbers, use 계산.

일관하다.m: to be consistent, to stick to one approach throughout
일관하다.x: He remained silent to the very end.
일관하다.t: Pattern: N(으)로 일관하다, e.g. 침묵으로 일관하다 = to stay silent throughout.

소원하다.x: After I moved, my friend and I gradually drifted apart.
소원하다.t: Usually 소원해지다 or 관계가 소원하다; don't confuse it with the noun 소원 'a wish'.

판이하다.ex: 두 형제는 얼굴은 닮았지만 성격은 판이하게 달라요.
판이하다.x: The two brothers look alike, but their personalities are completely different.
판이하다.t: Very common in the pattern 판이하게 다르다 'utterly different', even though it sounds redundant.

험난하다.x: He traveled a rough road before he succeeded.

무던하다.m: easygoing, good-natured, tolerant; fairly good, decent
무던하다.ex: 그 친구는 성격이 무던해서 누구하고나 잘 지내요.
무던하다.x: That friend is so easygoing that he gets along with anyone.
무던하다.e: Adverb 무던히 shifts meaning to 'quite a lot': 무던히 애쓰다 'to try really hard'.

저변.m: base, foundation; grassroots, broad base (of support or participation)
저변.ex: 생활 체육의 저변이 점점 넓어지고 있어요.
저변.x: The base of everyday sports participation is gradually widening.
저변.e: Literally 'bottom side', like the base of a triangle.
저변.t: Common collocation: 저변을 확대하다, 'to broaden the base (of participation).'
